# Yaba College of Technology Admission Requirements 2025/2026

Yaba College of Technology (YabaTech), Lagos State, Nigeria.

## General Admission Requirements

UTME Cut-off Mark: 150

**O-Level Requirements:** Five (5) credits at not more than two (2) sittings, including English Language, Mathematics, and three relevant subjects.

**Post-UTME:** Not required.

**Aggregate Formula:** (UTME/8) + (O-Level/9)

## Schools and Departments

- School of Applied Sciences
- School of Art, Design and Printing
- School of Business and Management Studies
- School of Engineering
- School of Environmental Studies
- School of Industrial and Production Engineering
- School of Science and Technology
- School of Technical Education

## Programs Offered

- National Diploma (ND) in Computer Science
- National Diploma (ND) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering
- National Diploma (ND) in Accountancy
- National Diploma (ND) in Business Administration
- National Diploma (ND) in Mass Communication
- Higher National Diploma (HND) in Computer Science
- Higher National Diploma (HND) in Electrical Engineering

## School Fees (2025/2026 Session)

- ND Tuition: ₦75,000 per session (indigene)
- ND Tuition: ₦120,000 per session (non-indigene)
- HND Tuition: ₦85,000 per session (indigene)
- HND Tuition: ₦130,000 per session (non-indigene)
- Acceptance Fee: ₦25,000
- Hostel Accommodation: ₦40,000 per session
